shapeSummary: Flat rectangular PCB, 65 mm (X) × 56 mm (Z) × 1.6 mm thick (Y from 0 to 1.6), with 3 mm corner radii and four 2.75 mm through mounting holes on a 58 × 49 mm Raspberry Pi HAT pattern. Components, pads and connectors are not modeled.
warnings: Board thickness of 1.6 mm is assumed (standard PCB); height is not given in the data.
Hole diameter (2.75 mm) and spacing (58 × 49 mm) are taken from the Raspberry Pi HAT spec, not from a printed dimension.
Corner radius of 3 mm is assumed from the HAT spec.
SMT components, through-hole pads, buttons, USB connector, switch and LEDs are omitted because their heights and positions are uncertain.
cadquery:
t = 1.6
board = cq.Workplane('XY').box(65, t, 56, centered=(True, False, True)).edges('|Y').fillet(3.0)
holes = (cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, t, 0))
         .pushPoints([(-29, -24.5), (29, -24.5), (-29, 24.5), (29, 24.5)])
         .circle(2.75 / 2).extrude(t))
part = board.cut(holes)
